To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the market structure emerges from the simultaneous interaction between the traders and the market; 2) the traders’ strategies are shaped by the market environment; 3) the traders’ past and forward time horizons are key factors in the evolution of their strategies; and 4) the traders’ economic performance depends on the market environment and the time horizons.
the best trading strategies are those with a 1 year forward time horizon.
the market environment and the time horizon of the traders’ strategies are important factors that affect the evolution of the trading strategies, which in turn affects the market structure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of heterogeneous traders’ time horizon and the impact of their trading strategies on the market dynamics.
the role of heterogeneous agents’ time horizon and past experience in formulating computational models.
the emergence of market structure, the evolution of trading strategies and the role of time horizons.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
short-memory horizons and computational models are best suited for modeling the dynamics of financial systems.

a trader’s performance is a function of the trader’s ability to forecast, and the ability to forecast is a function of how the trader’s past and forward time horizons are conditioned by the market environment.
the time horizon is an important parameter in the modeling of financial systems and should be considered in the design of the computational models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a trader’s time horizon should be as short as the market environment’s time horizon.
the market environment is conditioned by the past and future time horizons of the traders’ strategies.

a forward time horizon is a better predictor of future market conditions and that the best strategy to follow is to be flexible and to adapt to changing environments, which is the main feature of the evolutionary approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the past and forward time horizons of the agents are important factors for the emergence of market structure and for the conditioning of strategies by the market environment.
a trader should not rely only on a long-term strategy, but also on short-term strategies to adapt to changing market conditions.
the past and forward time horizons play a significant role in modeling economic systems with heterogeneous agents.
